# Jay Cuthrell

> William J. Cuthrell (Jay) is an innovative technology executive and sought-after servant leader. He is a prolific influencer and writer who communicates with ease at C-suite and practitioner levels across traditional and emerging mediums on digital transformation strategy in holistic full-stack engagements.

- [Cuthrell Consulting](https://cuthrell.consulting): Jay is the Founder and CEO, providing pragmatic Generative AI (GenAI) infused advisory services.
